description: The 10 busiest identities across the top, and the 25 index families they read most down the side; cell colour is requests on a log scale, teal (fewest) through blue and purple to pink (most). A data stream and its backing indices are one family, as is a run of dated daily indices; wildcard and date-math expressions are left out. A blank cell means that identity did not touch that family in range — or touched it too little to be among the 500 busiest identity/family pairs. A request naming several indices counts once per index. An identity that reads as an opaque id is a principal whose events carry no email and no key name — usually an organization-level Elastic Cloud API key, which the audit stream records only by its id; one the audit names as such is labelled "· Cloud API key". Cells keep a heatmap's size and pack to the top left when only a few identities or families are in range, so a sparse window draws a small matrix with its legend under it, not a few cells adrift in the panel.

text.expr: length(data('rows')) ? '' : 'No activity for this selection in this time range'

url.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE LOCATE(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices, "*") == 0 AND NOT attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE "<*" | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>") | EVAL idx = REPLACE(REPLACE(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices, """^\.ds-""", ""), """[-.]?\d{4}[.-]\d{2}[.-]\d{2}(-\d+)?$""", "") | STATS events = SUM(n) BY actor, idx | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 500 | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT actor RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), actor)

values.expr: !(length(data('rows'))) ? [] : floor(log(domain('color')[1]) / LN10 + 1e-9) - ceil(log(domain('color')[0]) / LN10 - 1e-9) >= 1 ? slice([1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000, 10000000, 100000000], ceil(log(domain('color')[0]) / LN10 - 1e-9), 1 + floor(log(domain('color')[1]) / LN10 + 1e-9)) : domain('color')[1] > domain('color')[0] ? domain('color') : [domain('color')[0]]
